title: AI, Machine Learning & Robotics by Dr. Giby Raphael
html:
https://youtu.be/jS47Y3RiFTM?si=bRlhN81T2oFf47cq
 
  “AI, Machine Learning & Robotics /  Ps. Abraham Varghese Dr. Giby Raphael, Br. Caleb” — from the Bethel AG Church Bangalore channel.

This episode explores Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Robotics from a perspective that blends technical concepts with broader implications, including ethical, societal, and faith-related viewpoints. 

Dr. Giby Raphael is a technology leader, pastor, and entrepreneur known for his work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, robotics, business, and Christian ministry. 

📌 Professional & Academic Background

  • He holds advanced academic credentials, including a Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, along with multiple master’s degrees such as an MBA and technical degrees in engineering and computer science. 

  • His work in technology includes research and innovation in AI and humanoid robotics with patents and publications to his name, positioning him as an expert in those fields. 

  • He has also spoken at major industry events, such as the AI Summit in Silicon Valley. 

💼 Professional Roles

  • CEO of Revobots a U.S.-based tech company focusing on robotics and related technologies. His leadership in tech blends business strategy with cutting-edge AI and robotics development. 

🙏 Ministry & Church Involvement

  • Dr. Raphael serves as an Associate Pastor at Faithcity Church, Kochi (India), where he is involved in teaching, mentoring, and spiritual leadership within the congregation. 

  • His ministry reflects an interest in applying faith-centered leadership alongside his professional expertise. 

In summary: Dr. Giby Raphael is a multidisciplinary professional bridging AI, robotics, business leadership, and Christian ministry, known for both his technical achievements and pastoral contributions.
